title: Recheck conformance on the qualified Java semantics source
description: Run the explicit and automatically selected JBMC corpus and the confirmation corpus against their original JVM witnesses. The qualified source now resolves checked enum names and thread-local initializers, follows JDK deque operations and integer formatting, and preserves exception details as an explicit boundary.
